needs.what: an op 'the Ring tempts you' (701.54): the player gets the emblem-level Ring with its next ability unlocked and chooses a creature they control as Ring-bearer; plus a per-game count of how many times the Ring has tempted a player and a condition 'this permanent is your Ring-bearer'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No ring/tempt op, Ring-bearer designation, or tempt counter exists in ops, condition_keys or value_keys; life_gained_this_turn covers the intervening-if, but the effect and the follow-up condition have nothing to map to
